AUTHORITARIAN.Definition: controlled by leaders who have total power and allow people little freedom

CONSTITUTION.Definition: the set of basic laws that say how a country must be governed

OPPRESSIVELY.Definition: in a cruel and unfair way that takes away people's freedom

CULT OF PERSONALITY.Definition: a situation in which a leader is shown as a hero and almost worshipped by the people

LIP-SYNCHING.Definition: moving your lips as if singing or speaking while a recording plays

BANISHED.Definition: officially sent away and kept out

DOTING.Definition: showing great love and care, sometimes too much

ALLEGEDLY.Definition: according to what people say, although it has not been proved

AN IRON FIST.Definition: a very strict, harsh and controlling way

SCRAMBLE.Definition: a hurried, disorganised struggle between people to get something

BREED.Definition: a particular type of animal, developed by people over time

NICKNAME.Definition: an informal name used instead of someone's real name

BREEDER.Definition: a person who keeps animals in order to produce young ones

PREDECESSOR.Definition: the person who had the job before him

RUMOURS.Definition: stories passed from person to person that may not be true

RALLY CAR.Definition: a fast car built for racing on roads and rough tracks

ALL WELL AND GOOD.Definition: fine, but not the whole story

PROSPERITY.Definition: money, success and a good standard of living

PARADOX.Definition: a situation that seems impossible because it contains two opposite facts

KNOCK-ON EFFECT.Definition: an indirect result caused by something that happened first

DRASTIC.Definition: extreme and having a strong, sudden effect

TOPICAL.Definition: connected with something in the news at the moment

NEUTRAL.Definition: not taking sides in conflicts between other countries
